reason: I only hire people another local owner has vouched for, and nobody I know has used him. He's a stranger working from Kuwait with no UK clients and demo sites for made-up businesses, so it reads like the other cold DMs I've had this month.
objection: No one I know can vouch for him, and if something breaks or he disappears I've got nobody local to chase. Pay-when-happy is nice but my time and my business's name on the line still cost me.
would_change_my_mind: A local owner I trust telling me he built their site and it went well.
